localDevelopmentPolicy.replacementGate: Fresh source inventory must show zero active consumers; migration, rollback, behavioral probes and clean/supported-upgrade parity remain mandatory.

surfaces.usageMeasure: Governed/legacy HTTP counters plus read-only activity since the declared cutover checkpoint and registered consumer source inventory.
surfaces.compatibilityWindow: No fixed minimum duration; require a production evidence checkpoint and 14 consecutive days at zero legacy usage after consumer cutover.
surfaces.removalGate: Consumer migration, zero-use window, rollback rehearsal, three approvals and matching clean/upgrade immediate pre-retirement parity must all pass.
surfaces.migrationAction: Drop request children, evidence, validation, materialization and header in dependency order after archived evidence export verification.
surfaces.consumerMigrationGate: Every registered service, UI and integration consumer uses document.entity_case and its domain materializers.
surfaces.rollbackGate: Restore rehearsal proves the final pre-retirement backup and forward-fix recovery procedure.

surfaces.usageMeasure: Repository source inventory plus pg_stat_statements reads that reference the aliases column, observed for the bounded production window.
surfaces.compatibilityWindow: No fixed minimum duration; require a production evidence checkpoint and 14 consecutive days at zero cache reads after normalized-reader cutover.
surfaces.removalGate: Normalized-reader cutover, zero-use window, cache recovery rehearsal, three approvals and matching clean/upgrade immediate pre-retirement parity must all pass.
surfaces.migrationAction: Remove cache synchronization trigger/function dependencies, then drop master.business_partner.aliases.
surfaces.consumerMigrationGate: All readers query effective-dated master.business_partner_alias rows.
surfaces.rollbackGate: Cache-disable and rehydration rehearsal proves forward recovery from normalized alias authority.

surfaces.usageMeasure: Repository source inventory, pg_stat_statements column reads/writes and normalized-versus-flattened dual-write mismatch count.
surfaces.compatibilityWindow: No fixed minimum duration; require a production evidence checkpoint and 14 consecutive days at zero flattened-coordinate use after normalized cutover.
surfaces.removalGate: Normalized command/resolver cutover, zero use and zero mismatch, reconstruction rehearsal, three approvals and matching clean/upgrade immediate pre-retirement parity must all pass.
surfaces.migrationAction: Remove compatibility materialization triggers and flattened-column FKs/indexes, then drop the listed columns.
surfaces.consumerMigrationGate: Commands write and resolvers read only normalized decision-scope rows with zero dual-write mismatch.
surfaces.rollbackGate: Normalized-to-flattened reconstruction rehearsal proves reversible data recovery.

surfaces.replacement: governed workforce case plus Studio IAM saga projections
surfaces.usageMeasure: Workforce projection command/consumer counters, activity since the declared cutover checkpoint and outstanding pending/failed compatibility rows.
surfaces.compatibilityWindow: No fixed minimum duration; require a production evidence checkpoint and 14 consecutive days at zero compatibility intake after all workforce consumers migrate.
surfaces.removalGate: Internal/external workforce cutover, zero use, zero outstanding rows, lifecycle restore rehearsal, three approvals and matching clean/upgrade immediate pre-retirement parity must all pass.
surfaces.migrationAction: Retire its command, trigger, grants and indexes before dropping document.workforce_iam_projection.
surfaces.consumerMigrationGate: All internal/external workforce producers and consumers use governed case/outbox/IAM saga contracts and no pending or failed compatibility row remains.
surfaces.rollbackGate: Provision, suspend and deprovision restore rehearsal passes without recreating Person, worker or engagement authority.

surfaces.replacement: organization-only master.business_partner plus independent Person/Workforce authority
surfaces.usageMeasure: Historical non-organization row count, legacy-link count, import/request/section source inventory and production branch counters.
surfaces.compatibilityWindow: No fixed minimum duration; require a production evidence checkpoint and 14 consecutive days at zero person/group compatibility use after consumer cutover.
surfaces.removalGate: Zero historical rows/links/use, organization-only consumer cutover, authority restore rehearsal, three approvals and matching clean/upgrade immediate pre-retirement parity must all pass.
surfaces.migrationAction: Preflight historical rows, remove compatibility branches/link authority, and rebuild the enum without person/group values using a forward migration.
surfaces.consumerMigrationGate: All listed import, request and section consumers are organization-only and historical non-organization rows are zero.
surfaces.rollbackGate: Historical-coordinate export and restore rehearsal proves no Person/Workforce authority loss.

surfaces.replacement: implemented DDL, accepted ADR rejection, or durable backlog disposition for every inventory item
surfaces.usageMeasure: Inventory completeness checker unresolved-item count and repository references treating the inventory as active authority.
surfaces.compatibilityWindow: Retain until every item is disposed and no active runtime/release check depends on the document; production timing does not shorten schema-surface windows.
surfaces.removalGate: Zero unresolved items, zero active authority references, disposition review, rollback through Git history and all required approvals must pass.
surfaces.migrationAction: Remove the temporary inventory only after its completeness checker reports zero unresolved items.
surfaces.consumerMigrationGate: No active plan or check treats the inventory as runtime authority.
surfaces.rollbackGate: Git history remains the recovery mechanism after documented disposition completeness is certified.
